column1: # Known differences of lodwright 0.15.0 (default request, every option off) against the game's own LOD tree (10 plugins: FalloutNV and its DLCs, issue #147).

# Measured on the v0.15.0 release binary with `lodwright verify --reference <game tree> --known-differences docs/known-differences/0.15.0.tsv`: exit 0, 0 unlisted differences, 0 stale entries; block paths and reasons only, no game data.

# Changes from 0.12.0: none. The entries are those of 0.12.0 (417); releases 0.13.0 to 0.15.0 changed no default output (the speed-up #257 is byte-identical, the water settings and output.pack are off by default).

# Per level, as verify prints it: water overlap (blocks, under 0.95, mean) level 4 216, 72, 0.892; level 8 87, 39, 0.834; level 16 36, 29, 0.724; level 32 8, 8, 0.688; overall 347 blocks, 148 under 0.95, mean 0.855. Object blocks exact: 446 of 551.

# Terrain heights are not listed per block: 3040 of 3529 compared blocks differ by more than 1 unit (level 4 2231 of 2666, level 8 633 of 687, level 16 160 of 160, level 32 16 of 16) because the game's block is a different
# vertex selection of the same land heights (measured in #241, docs/spec/terrain-lod.md section 8); `verify` reports the numbers, no entry accepts them.
# Fields: path, release expected to remove it, reason (tab separated; format in docs/contracts.md, Verify).
